title: Page 74
transc:
1030 pm 
R O Brien  Washn May 19th 1864
Reliance May Hope to Knave your mangle of Nancy
yesterday asking for weakness reached here this morning and
was submitted to the Ida & by his direction
transmitted to Juno for his instructions zebra All the
saints of the govt as you know are under
his orders & to be disposed of as he
may direct zodiac The available whinny at grapes have
all been forwarded to him zebra great interest is
felt by the Ingrate & this quadroon in the
success of your operations & by holding the ridge
in ragged of you John is to that extent
relieved & you will contribute greatly to the success
torch campaign zebra Nothing in our power will be
spared to support you and add to the important
results you have already obtained Webster Bruno Corunna taken


R O'Brien  Wash'n May 20th 1864 
Growl May Harrow Elizabeth For Knave unity The Amen has
been scanned by the navy zebra Shannons are at Carroll
zodiac Whelp morning a fleet of supplies and for Whig
of Wilkes will attempt to as cend the Windsor Zebra
Can you send some of your Wiard or other Shannons
with orders to protect the fleet & to scour the
Windpiper for boats & prevent the planting of Torpedoes Bender
